decisions.reason: The GIS solution platform is close to the core business and gained its own page in 2019, so it likely meets aspirations as a reusable architecture underpinning integrated solutions and gives no cause for problemistic search.

Mobile field data capture fits customer needs in the public sector and utilities and stayed on its own page in both years, so with growing industry turnover and available slack the firm can keep carrying it even though recent evidence is missing.

The search extension was actively updated to version 1.6.0 in 2019, which signals ongoing investment and acceptable results within the firm's map.apps ecosystem, unlike the smaller plugins that were already pruned.
